fixed_point_model.loss_gain_rule: absolute adjacent difference |C(n+1)-C(n)|; sign 益 for n=0..83, 損 for n=84..167
fixed_point_model.generic_line_speed_rule: 遲=mean-minus-adjustment and 疾=mean-plus-adjustment in 益 half; swap signs in 損 half; carry any nonzero sub-秒 residue to the printed 秒 place

primary_chiji_table_schema.shortcut_formula_source: 損益分以日率八百二十分而一；滿日率為秒，不滿為微纖
primary_chiji_table_schema.shortcut_integer_identity: If 損益分 is stored as 1e-6 fen integer F, 1e-4-second shortcut units = floor(F / 820).

primary_xingdu_table_schema.shortcut_formula_source: 置八百二十以遲行度而一為捷法
primary_xingdu_table_schema.fixed_point_note: The divisor is the source table's 1e-4-degree integer representation of the corresponding line speed; shortcut is a source fixed-point multiplier, not modern SI time.
